name: cordo
description: Explore streams, query events, and investigate ops findings in Cordo from Cursor.

CORDO_API_TOKEN.title: Cordo API token
CORDO_API_TOKEN.description: Personal access token created under Cordo Settings → API tokens. Prefer a read-only token (streams:read + events:read); add write scopes only when the agent should change streams, views, monitors, channels, or keys.
